mapper.select: select link_id, user_id, source, target, type, create_time from gantt_link where user_id = #{userId} order by create_time
mapper.insert: insert into gantt_link (user_id, source, target, type, create_time) values (#{userId}, #{source}, #{target}, #{type}, #{createTime})
mapper.delete: delete from gantt_link where source = #{taskId} or target = #{taskId}
